method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: random-cat-fact
tools.title: Random Cat Fact
tools.description: Get a single random cat fact, optionally limited to a maximum character length.

max_length.description: Maximum character length of the returned fact.

tools.name: list-cat-facts
tools.title: List Cat Facts
tools.description: List cat facts as a JSON array, optionally filtered by maximum length. Default limit 10, maximum 1000.

max_length.description: Maximum character length of returned facts.

limit.description: Number of facts to return (default 10, maximum 1000).

tools.name: list-breeds
tools.title: List Breeds
tools.description: List cat breeds as a JSON array. Default limit 25, maximum 1000.

limit.description: Number of breeds to return (default 25, maximum 1000).
